# Undercut

> Undercut is an automated eBay repricer for small and mid-size sellers. It reprices each listing to beat the lowest competitor automatically, clamped to a per-item hard price floor (cost + fees + minimum margin) it will never cross — so automation can't gut margins. Free tier (25 listings, no credit card), paid plans $29 / $79 / $199 per month, annual plans ~2 months free. Every account starts with a 14-day Starter trial, no card.

Live app: https://undercutpricer.com
Positioning: simpler and cheaper than StreetPricer, RepricerExpress, and Informed.co; the hard floor is the centerpiece, not a buried setting.
Best for: eBay sellers/resellers with dozens to a few thousand competitive listings. Not for one-of-a-kind items with no price competition.

## Facts
- Repricing frequency: hourly (Free/Starter) → every 15 min (Pro and Scale; Scale runs every cycle)
- Hard floor + optional ceiling per listing; every reprice is logged
- AI (Claude) tunes undercut aggressiveness on Pro and above
- 1-click eBay OAuth connect; listings import automatically
- Plans: Free $0 (25 listings) · Starter $29/mo (100) · Pro $79/mo (1,000) · Scale $199/mo (10,000)
- Season Pass: $145 one-time, 90 days of Starter-level access (100 listings), no subscription, no recurring charge. Buying it again extends the window.
